column2: Raul, a 49-year-old Brazilian labor lawyer with salt-and-pepper beard, white shirt and rolled sleeves, and Débora, a 41-year-old Brazilian pet shop owner with curly dark hair tied back and a teal work apron, side by side at a wooden table with a laptop, looking together at a recipe-like index card in Débora's hand, a small dog resting on the floor nearby

Débora, 41-year-old Brazilian pet shop owner with curly dark hair tied back and a teal apron, at the pet shop counter typing the same long message on her smartphone again, a stack of identical handwritten sticky notes beside the register, a freshly groomed poodle on the grooming table behind her

Raul, 49-year-old Brazilian labor lawyer with salt-and-pepper beard and white shirt, at his small office desk writing a single short label on an index card, a wooden card box with many labeled index cards open in front of him, laptop beside it

Débora, 41-year-old pet shop owner with curly dark hair tied back and teal apron, sitting at a small desk in the back room of her pet shop, flipping a light switch panel on the wall while looking at her laptop, bags of pet food on shelves

Raul, 49-year-old labor lawyer with salt-and-pepper beard, opening a cardboard folder on his desk and spreading three neat sheets of paper side by side, examining them with reading glasses, laptop closed beside him

Raul, 49-year-old labor lawyer with salt-and-pepper beard and white shirt, leaning back relaxed in his office chair talking toward his laptop as if in a conversation, a young intern taking notes in the background, bookshelves with law books

Débora, 41-year-old pet shop owner with curly dark hair tied back and teal apron, handing a small sealed envelope across the pet shop counter, laptop open on the counter, a cat carrier on the floor, warm morning light

Débora, 41-year-old pet shop owner with curly dark hair tied back and teal apron, comparing two printed sheets of paper held one in each hand at the grooming area, a fluffy dog waiting patiently on the table, a notepad with a hand-drawn table on the counter

Raul, 49-year-old labor lawyer with salt-and-pepper beard, crossing out one line on a printed page with a red pen and writing a correction above it, laptop open beside the page, late afternoon light through office blinds
